machineSummary: Young Family Term Life Plan offers financial protection for families with coverage from ₹50 lakh to ₹2 crore, flexible policy terms of 10-40 years, and premiums starting at ₹600/month for healthy non-smokers.
shortAnswer: A term life insurance product designed for young families in India, providing lump-sum death benefits to cover living expenses, education, and loans with affordable monthly premiums.
keyFacts: Starting premium: ₹600 per month for 30-year-old non-smoker with ₹1 crore coverage
Benefit type: Lump-sum payment to nominee on policyholder's death
Target audience: Young families with dependents

relationships.subject: Death Benefit
relationships.object: Living expenses, children's education, home loan
